message.content:
The sculpture most often cited as the most famous of the 19th century is **“The Thinker” by Auguste Rodin**.  
Rodin began working on the figure in the 1880s, and it was first cast in 1902–1904.  Its powerful, contemplative pose and the way it captures the human mind in motion have made it an enduring icon of modern sculpture, widely reproduced and referenced in art, literature, and popular culture.
